actions.action: Check top 1-2 inches of soil for dryness before watering
Water thoroughly only when top soil is dry
Empty the drainage tray so it doesn't sit full of water
Amend soil by mixing in perlite or orchid bark (about 1:2-3)
Gently check the roots for rot
If roots are rotten, trim them and let the plant dry out before watering
Cut off badly damaged leaves at the base of the stalk
Move plant to bright indirect light away from direct sun and drafts
Inspect leaf undersides and joints for spider mites or webbing
If mites are found, treat with insecticidal soap or a water spray on leaf undersides
